atDirectives.name: @tailwind
atDirectives.description: Tailwind CSS v3: inserts Tailwind's `base`, `components`, `utilities`, or `variants` styles into the CSS.

atDirectives.name: @apply
atDirectives.description: Inlines existing utility classes into a custom CSS rule.

atDirectives.name: @layer
atDirectives.description: Places custom styles in one of Tailwind's layers (`base`, `components`, `utilities`).

atDirectives.name: @config
atDirectives.description: Points the stylesheet at a JavaScript Tailwind config file (v3, or legacy config in v4).

atDirectives.name: @screen
atDirectives.description: Tailwind CSS v3: a media query for one of the configured breakpoints, by name.

atDirectives.name: @theme
atDirectives.description: Tailwind CSS v4: defines design tokens (colors, fonts, breakpoints, ...) as theme variables.

atDirectives.name: @source
atDirectives.description: Tailwind CSS v4: adds files or directories to scan for class names.

atDirectives.name: @utility
atDirectives.description: Tailwind CSS v4: defines a custom utility that works with variants.

atDirectives.name: @variant
atDirectives.description: Tailwind CSS v4: applies a Tailwind variant (e.g. `dark`, `hover`) to styles in CSS.

atDirectives.name: @custom-variant
atDirectives.description: Tailwind CSS v4: defines a custom variant.

atDirectives.name: @reference
atDirectives.description: Tailwind CSS v4: imports a stylesheet for reference (theme, utilities for @apply) without emitting its CSS.

atDirectives.name: @plugin
atDirectives.description: Tailwind CSS v4: loads a JavaScript Tailwind plugin.
